map.正弦波幅值 A 的 RMS 有效值 = A/√2，平均功率 = A²/2。: For a sine wave of amplitude A, RMS = A/sqrt(2), average power = A^2/2.
map.正弦波的 RMS（有效值）为峰值的 1/√2。: The RMS (effective) value of a sine wave is 1/sqrt(2) of its peak.
map.V_rms = V_pk / √2；市电 220 V 即有效值，峰值约 311: V_rms = V_pk / sqrt(2); mains 220 V is the RMS value, with peak about 311 V.
map.正弦峰值 Vpk 转有效值 Vrms = Vpk/√2。: Convert sine peak Vpk to RMS Vrms = Vpk/sqrt(2).
map.有效值 Vrms = 10 / √2 ≈ 7.071 V；施加 50Ω 负载功率: RMS Vrms = 10 / sqrt(2) ~ 7.071 V; applied to a 50Ohm load, power = 7.071^2/50 ~ 1.0 W.
map.若有效值 220V，则峰值 ≈ 220×√2 ≈ 311V。: If the RMS value is 220V, then peak ~ 220 x sqrt(2) ~ 311V.
map.为什么用有效值算功率？: Why use RMS to compute power?
map.有效值使交流与直流在电阻上产生同功率，是功率等效的直流当量。: The RMS value makes AC and DC produce the same power in a resistor; it is the DC equivalent of power.
map.非正弦也除以√2吗？: Do non-sinusoidal waves also divide by sqrt(2)?
map.不，√2 仅对正弦成立；其他波形有各自波形因数。: No, sqrt(2) applies only to sinusoids; other waveforms have their own form factors.
